sonnet.problem: Card 1 already says 'a son honors his father, and a servant his master.' That sets up the word 'honor,' so the right answer 'Where is My honor' is easy to pick out. It also lets the baker rule out the wrong answers by elimination.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The wrong answer 'A borrowed animal' reuses 'borrowed,' which was already shown as a wrong answer on card 4 ('borrowed' in the defiled/leftover/borrowed question).
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
